pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
Automatic and manual modes.
Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
redFlags: Payout promises with no processing detail.
No regulator, licence or audit named anywhere.
Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.
8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: Is Zephgain safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: The verdict on the product is cautious approval: it works, it includes a demo, and it should be used with the minimum deposit while the claims are unproven.
Our 4.1 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
